meta.title: DChat - Decentralized Messaging
meta.description: Private, secure, and censorship-resistant messaging powered by blockchain technology.

hero.headline: Messaging Without Boundaries
hero.description: DChat is a decentralized messaging platform that puts you in control. No central servers. No data harvesting. Just pure, encrypted communication.

items.title: Tri-Chain Architecture
items.description: Three specialized chains: Message Chain for 10,000+ TPS messaging, Currency Chain for DeFi, and Governance Chain for decentralized upgrades.

items.title: Zero-Knowledge Privacy
items.description: zkSNARK proofs hide sender/recipient metadata. End-to-end encryption with X25519 + AES-256-GCM. Your messages are truly private.

items.title: 21-Validator Consensus
items.description: Tendermint BFT with 3-second finality. Byzantine fault tolerant up to 7 malicious validators. Single-slot finality means no reorganizations.

items.title: 10,000 TPS Capacity
items.description: Parallel execution across 64 shards. Sub-500ms message delivery with optimistic confirmation. Epoch-level finality every 5 minutes.

items.title: DCHAT Token Economy
items.description: 1B total supply with 2% inflation. 50% fee burn creates deflationary pressure. Stake for 8-12% APY and governance voting power.

items.title: Smart Contract Platform
items.description: EVM-compatible Currency Chain. Build premium channels, NFT gates, and DeFi integrations. TypeScript SDK for rapid development.

steps.title: Generate Your Keys
steps.description: Create a cryptographic identity in seconds. Your private key stays on your device.

steps.title: Connect to the Network
steps.description: Join the decentralized network of validators spread across the globe.

steps.title: Start Messaging
steps.description: Send encrypted messages that only your recipients can decrypt and read.

security.headline: Military-Grade Protection
security.description: DChat leverages blockchain technology and advanced cryptography to ensure your communications remain private and secure.

cta.headline: Ready to Take Control?
cta.description: Join thousands of users who have already made the switch to truly private messaging.
